<observation>
  <type>discovery</type>
  <title>Picker system architecture — Vertico-style generalized UI</title>
  <subtitle>Picker module provides renderer-agnostic "type to drill down, Enter to act" UI pattern for multiple data sources</subtitle>
  <facts>
    <fact>Picker is a Vertico-style (Emacs-inspired) generalized UI component for buffer switching, LSP instance selection, fuzzy-finding, command palette, and diagnostics lists</fact>
    <fact>Architecture separates Picker (live state: query, cursor, raw/filtered candidates, selection), PickerSource (how candidates are built: Buffers, LspInstances, LspLocations), and PickerAction (dispatch on accept: SwitchToBuffer, OpenLspLog, JumpToLspLocation, etc.)</fact>
    <fact>Filtering uses case-insensitive substring matching via fuzzy_match with 5-tier algorithm (exact, prefix, word-boundary, substring, subsequence)</fact>
    <fact>Picker is renderer-agnostic by design — pure data model with no rendering code, allowing TUI/GPUI/web renderers to paint state independently</fact>
    <fact>Typed routing system uses RoutingPayload enum (Buffer, LspInstance, LspLocation, LspCompletion, LspCodeAction) with sidecar vec indexed via CandidateData::Extension, replacing prior tab-encoded string parsing</fact>
    <fact>Buffer switcher depends on stable sort preserving insertion order so alternate-buffer floats to top on empty query</fact>
  </facts>
  <narrative>The picker module in lattice-ui-tui implements a Vertico-style (Emacs-inspired) generalized picker pattern that powers multiple UI surfaces: buffer switcher (:b), LSP instance picker (:lsp-log), future fuzzy-finder, command palette, diagnostics list, and register/mark history. The architecture cleanly separates concerns: Picker owns live state (query buffer, query cursor, raw unfiltered candidates, filtered rendered candidates, selection cursor), PickerSource tags how candidates are built (Buffers walks BufferRegistry, LspInstances snapshots supervisor actors, LspLocations holds static location lists), and PickerAction tags dispatch behavior on accept (switch buffer, open LSP log, jump to location, accept completion/code-action). Filtering runs through lattice_completion::fuzzy_match with a 5-tier algorithm (exact, prefix, word-boundary, substring, subsequence) against candidate.display rather than candidate.text since text often carries routing payloads. The module is renderer-agnostic by design — it's a pure data model with no rendering code and no host-specific imports beyond lattice-completion, allowing TUI/GPUI/web renderers to read picker state and paint independently. A typed routing system replaced prior tab-encoded string parsing: each candidate carries a RoutingPayload enum variant (Buffer{id}, LspInstance{server_id, workspace}, LspLocation{path, line, col}, etc.) stored in a sidecar vec and indexed via CandidateData::Extension. The buffer switcher relies on stable sort preserving host-supplied insertion order on equal scores, ensuring the alternate-buffer floats to top on empty query.</narrative>

The `PickerAction` tag stays for now -- the App's\\n/// dispatch matches on it first to choose the code path; future\\n/// cleanup could pivot to matching on the payload variant alone\\n/// since the two always agree, but the redundancy is harmless.\\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\\npub enum RoutingPayload {\\n    /// `PickerAction::SwitchToBuffer` -- the host's buffer id\\n    /// (newtype-wrapped `u32` host-side; we hold the raw value\\n    /// to keep the picker module renderer-agnostic).\\n    Buffer { id: u32 },\\n    /// `PickerAction::OpenLspLog` / `OpenLspTraceLog` -- the\\n    /// supervisor key. `workspace` rides for completeness but\\n    /// today's handlers only use `server_id`.\\n    LspInstance {\\n        server_id: String,\\n        workspace: PathBuf,\\n    },\\n    /// `PickerAction::JumpToLspLocation` -- canonical `(path,\\n    /// line, col)` the host's `jump_to_file_line_col` consumes.\\n    /// LSP 0-based line + utf-8 byte column; the host already\\n    /// converted these utf-8 host-side at ingestion time.\\n    LspLocation {\\n        path: PathBuf,\\n        line: u32,\\n        col: u32,\\n    },\\n    /// `PickerAction::AcceptLspCompletion` -- numeric index into\\n    /// the host's `pending_completion_items` snapshot.\\n    LspCompletion { index: u32 },\\n    /// `PickerAction::AcceptLspCodeAction` -- numeric index into\\n    /// the host's `pending_code_action_items` snapshot.\\n    LspCodeAction { index: u32 },\\n}\\n\\n/// Where a picker pulls its raw candidates from.
